You would surely play this track in your next trip. Watch this rugged and refreshing number in the voice of Yo Yo Honey Singh from the movie Fugly starring Jimmy Sheirgill, Vijender Singh, Arfi Lamba, Mohit Marwah and Kiara Advani.
Song: Banjarey
Movie: Fugly
Singer: Yo Yo Honey Singh
Music Director: Yo Yo Honey Singh
Starcast: Jimmy Sheirgill, Vijender Singh, Arfi Lamba, Mohit Marwah, Kiara Advani
Lyrics: Yo Yo Honey Singh
Music Label: T-Series
